proofBoundary: Every declaration remains pending. Compiling assertions, process health, successful setup, and an expected baseline failure prove no persona cell. No UI, focus, browser menu, rendered fallback, or later implementation is qualified here.

contractDecisions.decision: Register every identity persona explicitly through the existing outcomeTest helper with its opt-in pending:'assert' mode. This mode uses ordinary test assertions without changing any declaration to proved. Existing callers retain expected-failure behavior. A stack-free subprocess test checks both passing and failing exit statuses and the unchanged pending declaration.
contractDecisions.reason: The loader requires explicit outcome registrations; an expected-failure wrapper would invert the baseline evidence this task needs. This is test-only helper behavior, not a product interface or registry change.

contractDecisions.decision: Use existing /v1/me/agents, /v1/me/session-agent and /v1/me/main-agent-preference. No new identity endpoint or browser storage mechanism is proposed.
contractDecisions.reason: Account authentication, current Agent representation, session choice and main preference have distinct existing owners.

contractDecisions.decision: The five represented Accounts each have their own Person and an organization provisioned by that Account. Discovery contains exactly those two Agents, with the genuine names and kinds. Another Account's Person is ineligible and selecting it returns 403 acting_context_denied, including for moderator and operator.
contractDecisions.reason: Creation receipts, Realm roles and platform roles cannot substitute for current Agent representation. This specification tests an ineligible candidate; revocation of a previously saved representation is a separate prerequisite, not fabricated here.

contractDecisions.decision: A fresh session with two eligible Agents and no saved choice has null session/main choices and null initialActingSubject. A saved Session Agent and Main Agent preference are independent. Explicitly clearing the session preserves its new revision and does not fall back to Main. On a new OAuth session, an eligible Main Agent is an initial suggestion, never a persisted Session Agent.
contractDecisions.reason: Null with a saved revision expresses deliberate unselection; it differs from an absent choice.

contractDecisions.decision: Create and verify a separate real Account without calling POST /v1/agents. With a genuine bearer, inventory is 200 complete items:[], and choice objects contain actingSubject:null, eligible:false, revision:null. Selecting a foreign Agent is 403. Reading a public chapter remains 200 with that same bearer and Account session.
contractDecisions.reason: An anonymous request or a test adapter with an empty list would not establish the signed-in empty premise.

contractDecisions.decision: Exercise actual Account sign-in and OAuth PKCE with an opaque state containing the requested next path, including nested percent-encoded query state. Observe the real registered callback and assert identical state and next. Owner failure, denied selection and stale revision preserve the Account and saved choices; recovery is an explicit new request with the same captured bearer.
contractDecisions.reason: API callback preservation is testable here. The consuming browser's redirect and local drafts remain pending browser proof.

contractDecisions.decision: For all seven public reader surfaces, a supplied invalid bearer returns 401 account_assertion_denied. Absence of a bearer permits the public baseline; presence of an invalid bearer cannot be discarded for an anonymous retry.
contractDecisions.reason: This is an explicit cross-surface contract to review before implementation. Existing public handlers that ignore optional authentication may fail it.

contractDecisions.decision: Use an original Book with a public selected catalogue contribution, a real book-composition, two content-text-v1 chapters, native Content publication and public search eligibility, and a separate explicit work-structure-publication-v1 receipt. The default unparameterized contents request, bounded contents continuation, chapter links, exact revision links, both audited and paged phrase search, and existing main-default text selection must read those published bytes.
contractDecisions.reason: Process Healthy, a successful create command, a private structure or an unpublished draft cannot establish a public reader premise.

contractDecisions.decision: The existing consumer starts at GET /v1/works/{uuid}/contents and follows the first available occurrence to GET /v1/chapters/{uuid}; its text fallback uses GET /v1/main-versions/{uuid}/selection. Test the default contents URL and both explicit/default-language selection URLs. Do not add a test-only start/read API or conflate catalogue introductory text with chapter content.
contractDecisions.reason: D4-008 retains independent content, navigation, reading-position and progress owners.

contractDecisions.decision: A public empty Book returns 200 contents items:[] and nextCursor:null. A private draft Book, a Book whose bytes have a native publication but no public eligibility/adoption, and an absent Book/occurrence have indistinguishable 404 work_unavailable bodies. Private, unpublished successor, unadopted and absent exact revisions have indistinguishable 404 revision_unavailable bodies, even for a signed-in owner using the ordinary public request.
contractDecisions.reason: Concealment cannot be an empty success or reveal resource existence, names, paths or revisions through error details.

contractDecisions.decision: A transparent proxy forwards actual Fuseki owner responses and can return only an explicit 503 failure. It never supplies successful source data. Identity reads with represented Agents must report 503 acting_context_unavailable. Known Work, contents and chapter reads must report 503 work_read_unavailable. Clear the fault and make one explicit retry; retain Account identity, exact saved revisions, Work identity/title/types and published chapter selections.
contractDecisions.reason: An unavailable owner is distinct from complete empty, denied, missing and concealed data. The API proof does not assert that a rendered UI retains its independent sections.

success.items: exactly the currently represented Agents; [] for the real verified empty Account

success.initialActingSubject: eligible suggestion IRI|null; null after an explicit session choice or unselection

apiMatrix.invariant: Does not overwrite the independently selected Session Agent.

request.continuation: same bounded query plus cursor returned by first page; no actingSubject

success.items: two available chapter occurrence/post/selectedRevision pairs in composition order; bounded pages contain one each
success.nextCursor: opaque string until final page, then null

apiMatrix.empty: 200 items:[], nextCursor:null for the public empty Book

success.previousAndNext: adjacent public occurrence IRIs or null at boundaries
success.content: actual exact Content owner bytes and digest, excluding the unpublished successor

reference.revisionId: published UUID, not its graph IRI
reference.byteDigest: digest returned by actual draft command

success.body: original catalogue introduction; separate from native chapter bytes

success.results: exactly two public published revision graph IRIs; each actual matchedPlacement links back to its Book occurrence

request.continuation: same body plus continuation set to the entire first response.next object

success.results: one distinct eligible revision per page; union equals the audited /queries response
success.next: opaque object on first page, null on last page

fixture.composition: Existing personaSessions and restorePersonaRealms run real Account OAuth, Main composition and lifecycle, Access, Content, graph, immutable objects and relay owners. No REZICS module mocks or successful fake source responses.
fixture.authority: Use the existing persona fixture's supported role/ownership commands and grantFixtureAuthority where required; no direct shared authority or business writes.
fixture.corpus: One command-created public Book (two chapters), public empty Book, private draft Book, native-published but publicly unadopted Book, unpublished successor to a public revision, five real represented people with their own organizations and one separately verified Account with no Agent.

rights.credit: Synthetic people, names, Book text and organization names authored for this fixture; no external content.

fixture.backup: Close all fixture writers and relay, stop PostgreSQL cleanly, and retain one consistent stopped copy of all owner volumes with createCorpusBackupDriver. Each prove file restores a separate disposable copy of that same backup; no reconstruction from successful response literals.
fixture.privateManifest: .temp/identity-reader/corpus.json (0600; retained credentials are never committed or printed)
fixture.assertionEvidence: .temp/identity-reader/assertions-<QA run id>.jsonl; append immediately before each reached HTTP/status assertion
fixture.budgetScope: Source startup, command creation, stopped backup, isolated restore, migrations and application startup count. Host admission wait is excluded by REZICS_QA_PREPARATION_STARTED_AT. A reused cut skips construction but measures its new restore. Preparation failure remains SETUP, never a product assertion failure.
fixture.reuse: Retain the same backup and recipe/storage compatibility digest. Reject incompatible reuse; preserve the old backup rather than silently rebuild.

baseline.pinProcedure: Commit this complete specification; detach this worker worktree at the product revision and overlay only the authored declaration, tests, test fixture and matrix. Verify the product/harness diff before running. Keep main and all other worktrees read-only.
baseline.expectedResult: Ordinary assertions may fail. Report the actual failing test body, reached assertion and actual response; never count setup, transport failure, health or a test.failing wrapper as the requested product failure.

remainingPrerequisites: G-2768 enrolls the pending identity row and the exact prove files without editing these declarations/assertions. Corpus-owning tests must receive the runner's appropriate isolation enrollment before wider prove campaigns.

The baseline must pin pristine product code, successfully construct the supported public publication and empty-Account premises, and finish preparation within 600 seconds before a claimed outcome failure.
A saved Agent whose representation is later revoked requires a supported independent fixture authority transition; do not manufacture private rows or an eligible:false success response.
Separate browser author proves rendered login return, menu/focus, and preserved independent sections. This API specification author has no browser execution authority.
